# Map style credits and licences

Bundled `../map-style.json` derives from https://tiles.openfreemap.org/styles/positron and https://github.com/hyperknot/openfreemap-styles.
Changes (2026-11-01): Chinese label preference, water colours and label density.
Map tiles, glyphs and sprites remain served by OpenFreeMap, and are not bundled.

Positron derives from https://github.com/openmaptiles/positron-gl-style and CartoDB Basemaps, designed by Stamen and Paul Norman for CartoDB Inc. (CC BY 3.0: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/).
Style design: CC BY 4.0, https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/.
Data attribution: https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright and https://openmaptiles.org/.
Upstream licence notices: https://github.com/hyperknot/openfreemap-styles/blob/main/LICENSE.md and https://github.com/openmaptiles/positron-gl-style/blob/master/LICENSE.md.
